metadata.title: Embedded minimal surfaces with three ends associated with the Hoffman-Osserman catenoids
metadata.abstract: For every positive integer $g$ and every Hoffman-Osserman catenoid in $\mathbb{R}^5$, we construct a complete embedded minimal surface of genus $g$ that is not contained in any proper affine subspace of $\mathbb{R}^5$. These surfaces can be viewed as higher-codimensional analogues of the Costa-Hoffman-Meeks surfaces, associated with the union of the corresponding Hoffman-Osserman catenoid and the plane containing its waist circle. We provide explicit Weierstrass data for these surfaces. Our construction can also be interpreted as restoring conformality to a deformed Costa-Hoffman-Meeks immersion by introducing two additional harmonic coordinate functions.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 高余维嵌入极小曲面的显式构造
analysis.workSummary: 对任意正亏格 g 和 R⁵ 中每个 Hoffman–Osserman catenoid，构造完整嵌入极小曲面，且充满 R⁵、不含于任何真仿射子空间。题名指出有三个端；曲面关联该 catenoid 与其腰圆所在平面的并，作为 Costa–Hoffman–Meeks 曲面的高余维类似物，有显式 Weierstrass 数据。也可解释为给变形浸入补两个调和坐标以恢复共形性。
analysis.breakthrough: 同时实现任意正亏格、完整嵌入和充满 R⁵，给出可直接研究的显式曲面族。
analysis.limitations: 环境为 R⁵ 且输入特定，未声称任意余维或端模型；不含唯一性、稳定性或分类结论，三端及端渐近应查正文。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。PDF 全 26 页文本提取完整、页数一致且无短文本页；全文检索未观察到作者使用生成式 AI 的披露，不据此推断未实际使用。

analysis.priorityReason: 极小曲面与几何分析紧密相关，宜看周期闭合、嵌入及端控制。
